at most one genuinely distinct architecture question survives ledger duplicate audit
entries.decision: Close RQ-021. The closed R1/R2 surface may not be repaired. Open one question about native higher-timeframe state-transition signals with state-conditional event termination.

a longer fixed M15 hold is the missing solution
static M15 direction remains stable across regimes
the isolated session-handoff cell justifies local repair

entries.origin_analysis: RQ-021 found architecture-wide cost fragility, direction switching in 562 of 660 cells and no robust fixed-horizon neighbourhood. The full R1/R2 universe used M15-local or session entries and unconditional fixed M15 exits.
entries.causal_hypothesis: A native H1/H4 state-transition architecture may be scientifically distinct because the primary signal and termination event are both defined on completed higher-timeframe structure rather than applied as filters or fixed-time exits to an M15 signal.
pre_result_predictions: H1/H4 bars can be derived deterministically from accepted M15 data without changing 2024
prior ledger comparison confirms native timeframe construction was not previously tested
a finite protocol can be frozen before any H1/H4 outcome is calculated
entries.decision: Remain descriptive and pre-outcome. Audit data construction, literature and ledger overlap, then define or reject one finite native higher-timeframe architecture protocol.
retained_findings: longer fixed holds do not form a robust neighbourhood
static long-horizon state overlays did not pass
session-scale continuation is the least-failed area but cannot be selected
new information must change primary signal construction rather than add a filter
prohibited_reuse: no reuse of R1 M15 cells as hidden candidates
no event-exit relabeling of Families C/D/G/H
no family preregistration before source and duplicate audit
successor_questions: Which completed H1/H4 state transitions have primary-source support?
Which termination event is causally paired and not a renamed checkpoint exit?
Can the data contract be frozen without opening outcomes?
